notes.title: Camera Invert, smoother controls and bonus "S" rankings update out now!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1554840/ss_55dd47a39e48aa91ec7f1e56bcc9ae2bd472a30f.1920x1080.jpg?t=1617984042I [/img]

finally finished the PC update for Toree 3D! It includes the following:

- Camera invert options
- Better analog gamepad stick controls
- New S ranks
- Bug Fixes
